parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the button of a pen, typically made of plastic, located at the top end of the pen.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to extend or retract the pen tip mechanism, controlling the writing state.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, engaging an internal spring mechanism to lock or release the pen tip.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body of the pen, made of plastic, serving as the housing for the ink cartridge and internal mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, holds the ink refill, and serves as the gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, providing a stable surface for holding and writing.
